source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
Bearer: a **CHAOS LORD** model, not a **TERMINATOR** or **JUMP PACK** model.

When you declare battle formations, the bearer can start in Reserves instead of on the battlefield. If it does, then in [your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) of a turn of your choice, you can pick a model in a **LEGIONARIES** or **CHOSEN** unit of yours that is on the battlefield, has 2 or more models left and is not an [Attached unit](vsdata:core-rule/attached-units).

That model is **destroyed**, with no rules that trigger on a model's destruction applying. Set the bearer up as near as it can be to the spot where that model died. It can be set up in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) only of enemy units that the destroyed model was in Engagement Range of. The bearer then becomes that unit's Leader, attached to it.
